note: Rated renders: scratchpad/w13 (m01-m19) and w13q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575. They were built at 17:35 from b13, which is 25ae23e: the w12 final with the bar bottles and tumblers changed to dielectric mid grey. b13/test.html contains bottleClear #6d7477 and no flapFrame or aluFrame. The w14-candidate commit 74e228b (17:52: insert frames, welcome cabinet, ash-flap frames, flight-deck door, brewer polish) is NOT in these renders and is not rated here. So the only rendered change since w12 is the bar glassware, and every other score carries over from w12a after a fresh look. Lighting is noted but not scored: the white wash on the upper galley compartments (m09 #a5a39f against sansY_44 #655b47), the flat grey q19 close-up and the over-bright soffit/ceiling at m12. Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 by luminance over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Script: scratchpad/raterA/samp.py.

details.note: +0.2 over w12a: the glassware is no longer black holes. The bottles and tumblers are still opaque matte grey, with no clear-glass cue or rims. The tumblers are slightly oversized and the counter guard rail reads as a fence across the front view. Layout, blind, screen, fridge column and ash doors match samchui_render_11.

Unchanged build. The cabinet is the main proportion error against lalf_134 and omaat_room_32: 0.53x the monitor width (photo about 0.8x), a 0.33 m gap of tower, and its top below the monitor top. The round knob latch remains. The ovens, panel, brewer niche and counter nosing are right.
Blue-grey square frames, three near-abutting flaps and coarse streaky ash, against lalf_133's spaced, rounded, warm-silver frames on separate panels.
